definition: Analyst profile reuses existing Ontic, independent causal power, InAct/esse and two-clause OwnerCommitmentAt. A thin profile is necessary because IntendedProfile already assumes the disputed commitment. Set/Form/math classification, mathematical relevance and world selection are independent. Productive cause means an outgoing action bringing about an effect, not mere mathematical explanation, formal participation, set membership, grounding or being caused. No transitivity, asymmetry, endpoint existence or well-foundedness is assumed; models explicitly have actual endpoints. Concrete-to-esse calibration, category-to-no-esse and relevance-to-production remain separate OPEN inputs. Paradigm set-of-two abstractness does not classify every set. Counterexamples are productive concrete event-sets/Forms and merely explanatory math relevance. An accessible-manifestation power control separates capacity from selected exercise. Generalization to reality remains OPEN.
note: Logic-first analyst comparison, attribution deferred. No new causal notion is established by its predicate name. Existing source claims and frozen generic Challenges retain their senses; this interface can test both commitment and its precise denial. See docs/notes/causal-concrete-rival-boundary.md.
